edit_prompt: Edit the image to evoke the excitement of a concert. General Intent: Transform the scene into the edge of an outdoor concert crowd. Editing Steps: Replace the bright daylight with dramatic, colorful stage lighting—beams of magenta and cyan—coming from off-camera. Darken the ambient light in the background. Enhance the woman’s expression to one of singing along joyfully, and the child's to an excited cheer. Add a slight lens flare effect to simulate powerful stage lights. The reflections in her glasses should show a distant, bright stage.
